data.one_liner: Generate video thumbnails on macOS and Windows.
data.what_it_does: This plugin creates a thumbnail image from a local video file. It works on desktop platforms and returns the thumbnail as a byte array.
use_when: You need a quick preview of a video file in a Flutter desktop app
You want a simple API without extra dependencies
You only target macOS or Windows
avoid_when: You require advanced video processing features
You are building a mobile app
data.setup_notes: Add macOS entitlements for file access as described in the README.
data.minimal_example:
final thumbnailBytes = await generateThumbnail(filePath: 'path/to/video.mp4');
Center(child: Image.memory(thumbnailBytes, height: 350, width: 350));
